title: PUBG MOBILE Introduces Midnight Hunters Theme
summary: PUBG MOBILE's 4.6 update introduces the Midnight Hunters theme, adding vampire and hunter-inspired gameplay elements to selected Classic maps.
content:
PUBG MOBILE's Version 4.6 update introduces the Midnight Hunters theme, bringing a new vampire and hunter-inspired experience to selected Classic maps.

The themed mode is available on Erangel, Livik, and Sanhok, with different themed areas and gameplay mechanics appearing across the supported maps.

Players can discover vampire areas, bell towers, Golden Bat statues, and special crates. These features add new objectives and interactions while exploring the map during a match.

Golden Bat encounters give players the opportunity to defeat a special target within a limited time and earn rewards. If the target is not defeated in time, it escapes.

The Midnight Hunters theme adds a dark supernatural atmosphere and new interactive elements to PUBG MOBILE's Classic battle royale experience.

faq.question: What is Midnight Hunters?
faq.answer: Midnight Hunters is the vampire and hunter-themed experience introduced with PUBG MOBILE Version 4.6.

faq.question: Which maps support Midnight Hunters?
faq.answer: The themed mode is available on Erangel, Livik, and Sanhok.

faq.question: What are Golden Bat statues?
faq.answer: Golden Bat statues are interactive objects that can trigger a special Golden Bat encounter. Defeating it within the time limit can provide rewards.

faq.question: Does Midnight Hunters change the normal battle royale gameplay?
faq.answer: The core battle royale gameplay remains, while the themed mode adds special locations, mechanics, and objectives.
